_comment: Authored replacements for entries whose gloss was the literal '[C2 auto-fill]' and whose example was the headword echoed back. Every one also needs its part of speech decided, since the pass that created them tagged all 290 as nouns regardless of what they are. Applied by scripts/apply-ca-glosses.ts, which re-checks each result with verifyEntry. Entries listed with "drop": a reason are artifacts rather than words - they keep their id so nothing is orphaned, but they are marked so they can never be taught.
